target.title: fix(nvidia): use Nemotron Super 1M context
target.body:
## Summary

Correct NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super metadata so OpenClaw uses the hosted model's documented 1,048,576-token context window without overriding future provider catalog corrections.

## Changes

- Update the bundled Nemotron 3 Super context window from 262,144 to 1,048,576 tokens.
- Normalize only the known stale 262,144-token NVIDIA featured-feed value.
- Preserve every other provider-owned live context value unchanged.
- Align NVIDIA provider documentation and focused bundled/live catalog tests.

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/nvidia src/agents/context-window-guard.test.ts` (52 tests passed)
- Extension production and test tsgo checks passed.
- Targeted oxfmt and oxlint checks passed.
- NVIDIA docs MDX and link checks passed.
- All three plugin import-boundary inventories passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh full-branch autoreview reported no accepted/actionable findings (0.93 confidence).

## Notes

- Existing explicit model overrides and `agents.defaults.contextTokens` caps remain authoritative.
- No config schema, CLI, gateway protocol, or Plugin SDK contract changes.
- The delegated changed-file gate could not start because the available Crabbox binary failed its version/help sanity check; no remote run was allocated.
- AI-assisted; I reviewed the implementation and validation results.

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where Nemotron 3 Super conversations could compact far earlier than the NVIDIA-hosted model's documented context capacity because both the bundled catalog and NVIDIA featured feed advertised 262,144 tokens.

## Why This Change Was Made

NVIDIA's hosted model page specifies 1M context, while its featured feed still returns the older 262,144-token value. OpenClaw now corrects only that exact stale value from its provider-owned bundled metadata, so a future different live limit passes through unchanged.

## User Impact

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super users can use the model's intended context budget before compaction unless they deliberately configure a smaller cap.

## Evidence

- NVIDIA's hosted model page advertises the `integrate.api.nvidia.com` endpoint and 1M context for Nemotron 3 Super.
- A regression test proves the stale 262,144-token feed value is corrected and a non-stale 524,288-token value is preserved.
- Bundled fallback, authenticated live catalog, catalog augmentation, and runtime context-guard tests pass.
